articles.title: JPMorgan earnings: 3 biggest takeaways
articles.summary: Yahoo Finance Video: JPMorgan earnings: 3 biggest takeaways. JPMorgan Chase (JPM) reported fourth quarter results that were a bit of a mixed bag for investors. Last week, the bank announced a deal to take over the Apple Card portfolio from Goldman Sachs. That deal weighed on the results. Net income in the quarter was $13 billion, including $2.2 billion in credit losses it planned for as a result of the deal. Net income would have been $14.7 billion in the quarter without the deal. Earnings per share without the costs were $5.23, higher than the $4.85 Wall Street estimates. Including costs from the Apple Card deal, earnings per share were $4.63. Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi shares his three biggest takeaways from the report and media call. articles.title: JPMorgan Chase (NYSE:JPM) Reports Q4 CY2025 In Line With Expectations
articles.mainIdea: JPMorgan Chase (NYSE:JPM) Reports Q4 CY2025 In Line With Expectations
articles.summary: StockStory: JPMorgan Chase (NYSE:JPM) Reports Q4 CY2025 In Line With Expectations. Global financial services giant JPMorgan Chase (NYSE:JPM) met Wall Streets revenue expectations in Q4 CY2025, with sales up 6.9% year on year to $46.77 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $5.23 per share was 7.7% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
